items:
Welcome to Skyline Shores, a vibrant 4-story coastal retreat in the quiet Grande Pointe community of Inlet Beach. With 5 bedrooms, 5 full baths, abundant balconies, and an observation deck boasting gulf views, this nearly 4,000 sq. ft. home blends colorful charm with modern comfort. Enjoy a community pool, bay access for kayaking and paddle boarding, and unforgettable sunsets from your private lookout.

Skyline Shores is a one-of-a-kind beach retreat designed for families and groups seeking both comfort and adventure. This 4-story, 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom home is uniquely decorated in a vibrant style and offers nearly 4,000 sq. ft. of living space, multiple verandas and balconies, a 2-car garage, and an observation deck with stunning views. Nestled in the peaceful Grande Pointe neighborhood of Inlet Beach, guests enjoy access to a community pool and the bay—perfect for kayaking, paddle boarding, or catching breathtaking sunsets—while still being just minutes from 30A, Rosemary Beach, dining, shopping, and the area's famous sugar-white sand beaches.

First Floor:


The entry level features two inviting bedrooms. One includes a twin-over-queen bunk bed with a Smart TV and veranda access, while the second offers two queen beds and a Smart TV. A full bathroom with a jetted tub and shower, plus garage and wet bar access, completes this floor.

Second Floor:


The heart of the home is here—an open kitchen, dining, and living space that flows onto a veranda with a bar and outdoor seating. Step down to the patio, complete with a grill and dining area. Inside, the kitchen boasts a breakfast bar for 4, while the dining table seats 8. The spacious living room provides plenty of comfy seating, a Smart TV, and ceiling fans. This floor also hosts a queen bedroom with an ensuite bathroom featuring a large walk-in shower.

Third Floor:


On this level, guests will find the spacious primary suite, featuring a king bed, couch, private veranda, generous closets, and a spa-inspired bathroom with a walk-in shower, jetted tub, and faux fireplace. A second queen suite with its own ensuite bath and ample closet space provides comfort and privacy for additional guests. A large storage closet is also available for added convenience during your stay.

Fourth Floor:


At the top, a quiet sitting area and full bathroom lead to the observation deck, where panoramic views and sunsets over the Gulf create unforgettable moments.

Whether you're lounging on a balcony, cooking a family meal, paddling the bay, or taking in the Gulf breeze from the top deck, Skyline Shores is designed for memorable coastal living.

Sleeping Arrangements
:

Skyline Shores offers well-appointed bedrooms across three levels for both comfort and privacy. For added flexibility, the home also includes a roll-out twin with mattress and a pack-and-play for little ones.

• Bedroom 1 (3rd Floor): King bed
• Bedroom 2 (3rd Floor): Queen bed
• Bedroom 3 (2nd Floor): Queen bed
• Bedroom 4 (1st Floor): Twin-over-Queen bunk
• Bedroom 5 (1st Floor): Two Queen beds

Convenient Location
Skyline Shores is ideally situated close to many of the Emerald Coast's top attractions. Guests can explore nearby state parks, stroll along the area's famous sugar-white beaches, enjoy world-class shopping, indulge in fabulous dining, and take part in a variety of water sports and outdoor adventures—all just minutes from your doorstep.

State Parks:

• Camp Helen State Park – At the west end of Lake Powell, offers hiking trails, birdwatching, fishing, and beach access.
• Deer Lake State Park – Known for its rare coastal dune lake, pristine beach, and scenic boardwalks.
• Grayton Beach State Park – One of Florida's most popular, with hiking/biking trails, kayaking, and a coastal dune lake.
• St. Andrews State Park (Panama City Beach) – Beautiful beaches, snorkeling, jetty walks, fishing, and boat tours to Shell Island.
• Eden Gardens State Park – Historic Wesley House, gardens, and oak-shaded walking trails near Point Washington.

Bays & Coastal Waters:

• Lake Powell – Florida's largest coastal dune lake, perfect for kayaking, paddle boarding, and nature viewing.
• Choctawhatchee Bay – Expansive bay ideal for boating, fishing, and sunset cruises.
• St. Andrews Bay – Clear waters, rich marine life, and access to Shell Island.

Marinas & Harbors:

• Bay Point Marina (Panama City Beach) – Full-service marina with charter fishing and boating access to the Gulf.
• Capt. Anderson's Marina (Panama City Beach) – Known for fishing charters, dolphin tours, and Shell Island trips.
• Destin Harbor (~30 min west) – Bustling harbor with dining, shopping, fishing fleet, and water excursions.

Trails & Outdoor Recreation:

• Timpoochee Trail (30A Bike Path) – 18.5-mile paved trail along Scenic Highway 30A, great for biking and jogging.
• Camp Helen Trails – Short nature trails with lake, dune, and beach views.
• Point Washington State Forest Trails – Miles of hiking and biking trails through pine forests and wetlands.
• Gayle's Trails (Panama City Beach) – Multi-use paved trail network connecting parks, conservation land, and neighborhoods.

Shopping Near Skyline Shores :

• 30Avenue (Inlet Beach) – Upscale shopping, dining, and lifestyle center.
• Rosemary Beach – Charming village with boutiques and galleries.
• Seaside – Iconic town center with coastal-inspired shops and markets.
• Pier Park (Panama City Beach) – Large open-air mall with national retailers and entertainment.
• Grayton Beach – Eclectic local shops, art galleries, and coastal finds.
• Alys Beach – Curated, luxury boutiques and design shops.
• Destin Commons (Destin) – Outdoor lifestyle mall with shopping, dining, and movies.
• Silver Sands Premium Outlets (Miramar Beach) – One of the largest outlet centers in the U.S.
• Seacrest Beach – Casual coastal shops and beach gear.
• The Big Chill (Watersound / formerly The Hub) – Family-friendly shopping, dining, and live entertainment.
• Peddlers 30A (Seacrest) – Local marketplace with small shops and bike rentals.

Local Restaurants Near Skyline Shores:

• Cuvee 30A (Inlet Beach) – Upscale coastal cuisine by celebrity chef Tim Creehan.
• amici 30A Italian Kitchen (30Avenue, Inlet Beach) – Wood-fired pizzas, pasta, and Italian specialties.
• amigos 30A Mexican Kitchen (30Avenue, Inlet Beach) – Tex-Mex classics and margaritas.
• Shaka Sushi & Noodle Bar (Inlet Beach) – Asian-fusion with sushi, ramen, and sake.
• Paradis (Rosemary Beach) – Fine dining with a focus on fresh seafood and steaks.
• Pescado (Rosemary Beach) – Rooftop dining and cocktails with Gulf views.
• La Crema Tapas & Chocolate (Rosemary Beach) – Spanish-style tapas and decadent desserts.
• The Donut Hole (Inlet Beach) – Famous for hearty breakfasts and fresh donuts.
• George's at Alys Beach – Seasonal menus with Southern flair and coastal inspiration.
• The Citizen (Alys Beach) – Modern coastal tavern with craft cocktails.
• Great Southern Café (Seaside) – Classic Southern comfort food with a coastal twist.
• Bud & Alley's (Seaside) – Gulf-front casual dining, a local institution for sunsets.
• The Big Chill (Watersound) – Open-air gathering spot with multiple eateries and live music.
• Shades Bar & Grill (Inlet Beach) – Family-friendly sports bar and American fare.

Nearby Towns:

• Rosemary Beach – European-inspired coastal town with cobblestone streets, boutique shopping, and elegant dining.
• Alys Beach – Known for its striking white architecture, luxury shops, and upscale restaurants.
• Seaside – Famous for pastel cottages, beachfront pavilions, and the iconic Airstream food trucks.
• Seacrest Beach – Family-friendly community with a large resort-style pool and bike-friendly streets.
• The Big Chill (Watersound) – Open-air venue with eateries, live music, and a family-friendly lawn.
• Grayton Beach – Eclectic mix of art galleries, local shops, and one of the most popular state parks.
• WaterColor – Scenic coastal community with nature trails, bike paths, and upscale dining.

End your days in the quiet Grande Pointe community by lounging at the large community pool, watching sunsets over the lake, or unwinding on one of the home's many verandas. When adventure calls, you're just minutes from all the excitement and charm that 30A has to offer. Whether you're traveling with family, friends, or a larger group, Skyline Shores promises comfort, connection, and a vacation to remember.

Guests have access to the entire property, along with the private neighborhood clubhouse, pool, and lake access / kayak launch..
